classification.difficultyReason: Introduce an altitude to form two right triangles, apply exact sine ratios and simplify surds.

content.prompt: Find the exact value of $x$ in each diagram. No calculators required.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and upper apex; left side 6, right side x, base angles 60 degrees at left and 45 degrees at right.
spec.mathematics: The side 6 is opposite 45 degrees; x is opposite 60 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side and angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base and let its length be $h$.

$$\begin{align*}\sin60^\circ&=\frac{h}{6}\\h&=6\times\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\h&=3\sqrt3\\\sin45^\circ&=\frac{3\sqrt3}{x}\\x&=\frac{3\sqrt3}{1/\sqrt2}\\x&=3\sqrt6\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and upper apex; left side 6, right side x, base angles 30 degrees at left and 45 degrees at right.
spec.mathematics: The side 6 is opposite 45 degrees; x is opposite 30 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side and angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base and let its length be $h$.

$$\begin{align*}\sin30^\circ&=\frac{h}{6}\\h&=6\times\frac12\\h&=3\\\sin45^\circ&=\frac{3}{x}\\x&=\frac{3}{1/\sqrt2}\\x&=3\sqrt2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and upper apex; left side 6, right side x, base angles 45 degrees at left and 60 degrees at right.
spec.mathematics: The side 6 is opposite 60 degrees; x is opposite 45 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side and angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base and let its length be $h$.

$$\begin{align*}\sin45^\circ&=\frac{h}{6}\\h&=\frac6{\sqrt2}\\h&=3\sqrt2\\\sin60^\circ&=\frac{3\sqrt2}{x}\\x&=\frac{3\sqrt2}{\sqrt3/2}\\x&=\frac{6\sqrt2}{\sqrt3}\\x&=2\sqrt6\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base and upper apex; left side 6, right side x, base angles 45 degrees at left and 30 degrees at right.
spec.mathematics: The side 6 is opposite 30 degrees; x is opposite 45 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side and angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the base and let its length be $h$.

$$\begin{align*}\sin45^\circ&=\frac{h}{6}\\h&=\frac6{\sqrt2}\\h&=3\sqrt2\\\sin30^\circ&=\frac{3\sqrt2}{x}\\x&=\frac{3\sqrt2}{1/2}\\x&=6\sqrt2\end{align*}$$
